items.title: Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Oneonta, New York, December 28, 2005
items.q: The Canovas — Judy, Zeke and Ann. Two sisters and a brother.

ctx.x: I’m curious about some of the vaudeville acts that you played for. Did you get to — could you see them performing while you were playing or were you in the pit?

Yes. We were in a pit, but we could look up on the stage. Bob Hope, he played his act twice, around 1930 and then he came back in ’31. Milton Berle. The Ritz Brothers. They were famous. The Canovas — Judy, Zeke and Ann. Two sisters and a brother. Not Houdini.
